recommended_motifs.title: Three bicycles, a conversation inside
recommended_motifs.section: Make room for the next conversation
recommended_motifs.support: Opening and ending explicitly return to Sisir Mishra’s recollection of three people arriving by bicycle for discussions; footnote sisir.
recommended_motifs.placement: After the final narrative paragraph, before navigation and Footnotes & Sources; book tail only if fits without creating a new art-only page.
recommended_motifs.caption: Arriving for a conversation.
recommended_motifs.prompt: A quiet horizontal monochrome ink vignette of three ordinary bicycles leaned at different angles beside a lightly suggested doorway. No people, no signs, no exact identifiable house, no antique-brand detail, no racing bikes. The slightly overlapping handlebars and wheels feel used and practical, not symmetrically displayed. Delicate black-brown lines, generous transparent negative space, no frame or lettering. Symbolic illustration of arriving to discuss work, not a reconstruction of an actual meeting.
recommended_motifs.limits: Bicycles are attested; parking arrangement, doorway and bicycle designs are imagined. Caption must not identify the house as Sisir’s actual residence.
recommended_motifs.strength: Strongest: a concrete recurring object already binds opening and ending; avoids another desk.

recommended_motifs.title: Material for someone else to begin
recommended_motifs.section: Final narrative paragraph before Footnotes & Sources
recommended_motifs.support: Opening recalls magazines, songbooks and photographs transported by mini-truck from Puri to Bhubaneswar; final paragraph describes material another person can begin with. Footnote origin identifies retrospective interview.
recommended_motifs.placement: Immediately after the final narrative paragraph, before notes/continue. Do not place in a passage implying recovered celluloid.
recommended_motifs.caption: Something kept, ready to be passed on.
recommended_motifs.prompt: A modest horizontal monochrome ink vignette of a shallow open archival box containing unevenly sized unlettered booklets and a small protective envelope, one hand gently supporting the box from beneath. No desk, film reel, readable title, recreated magazine cover, vehicle or recognisable person. Restrained black-brown drawing, sparse paper outlines, transparent negative space, no decorative border. Emphasise keeping and handing on material rather than picturesque decay.
recommended_motifs.limits: The documented objects support the motif; box/envelope/hand arrangement are symbolic, not evidence of Deo’s exact storage or conservation practice. Avoid cord tightly tied around fragile originals or loose exposed photo handling.
recommended_motifs.strength: Strong: collaborative custody and ongoing discovery rather than another lone-archivist portrait.

recommended_motifs.title: The work that travels with a rider
recommended_motifs.support: Official synopsis gives a delivery rider and family; director’s note concerns ratings, incentives and algorithmic work. Footnote zwigato.
recommended_motifs.placement: Optional after the final narrative paragraph and before Watch and explore, if it can remain beside prose. Do not force it onto print108 merely because space exists.
recommended_motifs.caption: A working life beyond the screen.
recommended_motifs.prompt: A small horizontal monochrome line drawing of an unbranded insulated delivery bag resting on the ground, its carrying straps folded naturally beside it, with one closed plain food container partially visible through the unfastened top. No person, vehicle type, company mark, readable order label, smartphone rating or film-poster composition. Quiet practical object, no poverty symbolism, generous transparent negative space. Symbolic accompaniment to a story about earning a living, not a prop copied from Zwigato.
recommended_motifs.limits: Delivery work is evidenced; this exact bag/container design is not inspected film evidence. Do not call it the character’s actual bag. A bag cannot summarise the wife’s work or the whole profile; omit if it narrows the ending excessively.
recommended_motifs.strength: Conditional third choice; less text-specific than the bicycles and retained papers. No need to generate it solely to achieve three additions.

placement_policy: Meaningful art follows the narrative and precedes Continue/notes; provider lists remain functional access apparatus.
Do not repeat a new motif as both hero and tail or assign it to another reading.
No new page merely to house a small ending vignette. Skip when prose and image do not comfortably fit.
Do not change narrative to justify artwork. Existing six motifs and documentary photographs remain unchanged.
limitations: Page mapping applies to the reviewed 252-page digital and 278-page print UX editions, not a subsequent reflow.
This pass inspected page text and retained independent visual review; no fresh full-size page visual inspection or fit measurement.
No historical object design has been certified; prompts explicitly distinguish symbolic invention from documented objects.
